prompts.text: Run9 fruit, part 1: write 3 fruit names of different lengths to .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/fruit.md
Run9 fruit, part 2: in .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/fruit.md, write each fruit's letter count beside it
Run9 fruit, part 3: put a line at the top of .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/fruit.md naming the longest fruit
Run9 timer, part 1: write the current time to .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/timer.md, wait about 10 seconds, and write the time again
Run9 timer, part 2: add the seconds between the two times in .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/timer.md as a third line
Run9 timer, part 3: add a line to .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/timer.md saying the timer strand finished, with the time
Run9 hooks, part 1: list the .ts and .tsx files under tools/prompt_queue/hooks in .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/hooks.md
Run9 hooks, part 2: beside each file in .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/hooks.md, write how many lines it holds
Run9 hooks, part 3: put a line at the top of .sessions/simple-queue-enhancements/demo/run9/hooks.md naming the longest file
